summary: F1 is fixed: the r1 traversal probe now exits 1 with one line, builds nothing, and deletes nothing; hostile names, symlinks at flat and at out/<name>, and the out/ symlink farm all hold. Two late local-only hardening items remain (rmSync TOCTOU on an intermediate swap; writes follow a pre-planted flat symlink). No user can reach a wrong result; both are tech-debt.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Tech-debt] review-b: removeFlatFolder (src/cli/forge.ts) has a TOCTOU window: rmSync deletes through a symlink swapped into an intermediate path component between realpathSync(flatDir) and rmSync (probe: an intermediate swap out/<name> -> symlink let rmSync delete through to the target; a leaf swap was refused and the target survived). Reaching it needs a concurrent local writer racing inside out/, so no CLI user can hit it; consider rename-then-delete or document the accepted race.

N2 [Tech-debt] review-b: writes follow a pre-planted symlink even though deletion refuses: with out/<name>/flat or out/<name> symlinked to another folder, the flat PNGs land in the symlink target (probe wrote front-level.png into both targets; both markers survived removal). Local-only, needs a pre-planted symlink inside out/; the removeFlatFolder realpath rule still guarantees nothing outside the real out/ root is ever deleted, including through the worktree out/ symlinks to the main tree.
evidence: HEAD matches audited_head_sha fc823ed14104a6b81e942f6a9a5e8b507aab949f; phase_base_sha is its ancestor; role_base_sha recorded as HEAD.

F1 withdrawn: the r1 traversal probe (./forge render ../measure/runs/chibi_sprouts_redesign_20261123/probe-r2/escape-asset --fast --bg none --flat --views front-level --size 64, through heavy-run.sh) now exits 1 with exactly one line 'Invalid asset name ...: an asset name has no path separator.', builds nothing, writes nothing, and the exclusively-created marker file survives.

F2 withdrawn: tests/render-options.test.ts now resolves ROOT from import.meta.url and HEAVY_RUN from an env override or a relative path, has a single ownership check (createExclusive), tests the real fixture path collision (no render starts), and afterAll removes the fixture plus its out/ dir guarded by realpath and the _flat-render-pin- prefix.
F3 withdrawn: the --size cap was a suggestion about pre-existing, unchanged behavior; it is not a regression and is out of this track's scope.

Hostile name probes (each exit 1, no build, marker survives): backslash (separator), absolute path, '..' and '.', newline (fails closed at the existence check), fullwidth slash 'sprout／pip' (not a filesystem separator), dot-start '.hidden' (allowed by checkAssetName, fails at existence).
NUL byte: node spawn rejects it before exec ('must be a string without null bytes'); the OS cannot pass NUL in argv.

Fixture-name happy path: '_flat-render-pin-rb<pid>' renders with exit 0 and writes only <name>.glb, stats.json, and flat/front-level.png under out/<name>/ (no views/); a second run removes a real prior flat dir (sentinel gone) and rewrites it.
Symlink at out/<name>/flat: removal refused (lstat isSymbolicLink), the target marker survives, the symlink itself survives.

Symlink at out/<name> to a temp folder: removal refused (realpath of the parent is not a direct child of the real out/ root), the target marker survives; the worktree out/ holds 1254 symlinks to the main tree and the realpath rule cannot be satisfied through them, so nothing in the main tree's out/ is reachable by the removal.

Asset file under assets/ as a symlink to a source outside assets/: accepted (vite reads through the symlink; read-side is inherent symlink semantics and needs a pre-planted link), but every write stayed under out/<name>/ (write-side boundary holds).

TOCTOU probe: rmSync recursive removes a symlink swapped in at the leaf without touching its target, but deletes through a symlink swapped into an intermediate path component (both swaps raced between realpath and rmSync to model removeFlatFolder).
